title: Attacker url observed in the wild: http://botnet.code.wf/Sakura.sh (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The URL http://botnet.code.wf/Sakura.sh was observed twice in attacker activity on 2026-11-11 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. It is associated with the ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer) and originates from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. This URL is used in attacker payloads for tool download, callback, or exploitation targeting. Organizations are advised to block and monitor this URL and review proxy, web, and WAF logs for any requests to it.
